name: skills
one_liner: A free grab-bag of small add-ons for Claude Code that do specific chores, like tightening up a project's instructions file or explaining a topic with a quick diagram.
buyer: There's no clear paying buyer for the collection itself — it's a set of free niche developer conveniences, useful but not something most people would pay for on their own.
business_use_cases: A dev team uses the 'improve-claude-md' skill occasionally to keep their project's AI instructions file from drifting into confusing bloat.
An engineer uses the 'design-control-loop' skill to bootstrap a scheduled automation (like a nightly report) instead of building the scaffolding from scratch.

money_ideas.idea: The company itself likely uses this as marketing for its core paid product (human-in-the-loop AI agent oversight); the skills themselves aren't the revenue driver.

steal_this: Not much to build here directly — it's a lead-gen freebie for a company's paid platform, not a standalone opportunity for someone else to build on.
